name: fjord
_note: Cool blue-slate — Nordic water. Accent rides ~H192 (designer deep teal #0e6e85 light, clear glacier cyan #6cc4dd dark — console-remake accepted ramp); the neutral ladder and paper ground re-hue cold off the accent, so paper/ink carry a blue-slate chill, never warm grey. Cool accents keep a warm-white on-accent per the flip.

_overrideReasons.reading-accent.light: formula's teal lands at L0.72 — too light to read as code.fg on the near-white code panel; pinned to a deep glacier-teal that clears contrast while staying a cool sibling of the slate accent (code.fg.light tracks this)
_overrideReasons.reading-accent.dark: formula's HSL173 skews green-mint; pinned a touch bluer (H188) so the dark reading/code accent stays in the cool fjord-water family
_overrideReasons.surface.dark: the neutral-ladder OKLCH L0.095 pick collapses to ~1.3% HSL-L — a crushed near-black that loses the cool tint; pinned to a designed slate near-black that grounds the page under bg (8%) and holds the Nordic-water temperature
